steps: Calibrate the torque wrench at least once a year
Be sure the bolt and nut threads are clean and dry
Run the nut down to near contact with the washer or bearing surface
Add the friction drag torque to the desired torque
Apply a smooth even pull when applying torque pressure
When installing a castle nut, start alignment with the cotter pin hole
When torque is applied to bolt heads or capscrews
If special adapters are used which will change the effective length of the torque wrench
Grip the wire in the jaws of the wire twister
Pull the knob, and the spiral rod spins and twists the wire
Squeeze handles together to release wire

a: Excessive twisting of the wire will weaken the wire
